subject.title: [Feature]: sessions_search — full-text search over the agent's own session transcripts

question: Should OpenClaw add a core gateway-backed `sessions.search` and `sessions_search` transcript search surface now, and should that surface use a per-agent SQLite FTS index with `sessions_history`-equivalent visibility and redaction?
rationale: This is not a mechanical bug fix: it adds a core agent tool, gateway RPC, stored transcript index, and sensitive transcript snippet surface while overlapping with the experimental memory-search session corpus.

options.title: Approve Indexed Core Search Seam
options.body: Add the additive gateway method and agent tool using a per-agent SQLite FTS index, event-driven maintenance, bounded backfill, and the same visibility/redaction contract as `sessions_history`.

options.title: Promote Memory Search Instead
options.body: Keep transcript content search in the memory plugin path for now and decide whether to make session indexing easier or default without a new core sessions tool.

options.title: Defer To Cross-Surface Session Search Design
options.body: Keep this as a tracker until the Control UI and mobile session-search requests settle the shared gateway API and result contract.

recommendation.title: Approve Indexed Core Search Seam
recommendation.body: Add the additive gateway method and agent tool using a per-agent SQLite FTS index, event-driven maintenance, bounded backfill, and the same visibility/redaction contract as `sessions_history`.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the maintainer-labeled issue and have recent adjacent session-management and memory-search history, making them the clearest owner for the product/API direction choice.
